entries.clue: Keep unseen watch on a suspect, as Blyton's Fatty does in yet another disguise
Winter knife work that opens an apple tree's crown to light and air
Shoot cut from a prized apple tree to be joined onto another's roots
Clear plastic guard worn at night to stop straightened teeth drifting back
Hidden knowledge shared only under a password, as in Blyton's young societies
Hoard of gold ingots the Five track down in a dungeon on their first outing
Gnawing pain from a rotten grinder that keeps a patient awake until dawn
Blyton's invented coastal name, attached to a bay, a farm and a castle
Badly behaved in a childish way, as Elizabeth Allen was at Whyteleafe
Dark chamber in the cliffs where Blyton's smugglers stow their haul
The one-word instruction that comes with a plastic cup of water and a bowl
Slow bubbling change in the vat from sweet apple liquor to strong drink
